about_the_game:
Everyone Fights is a turn-based strategy game where you build structures, recruit an army, and battle for land.

Choose from 20 unique commanders, each with their own special unit, building, power, super, and trait. Command your army to victory through a series of campaigns to take over the world!

Your goal is to capture enemy HQs while defending your own, whether battling AI, challenging friends, or playing through the campaign. Success requires managing both your army and city, building a powerful force to dominate the battlefield.

With a diverse array of units at your command, engage in tactical combat and adapt your strategy as the day and night cycle reshapes the fight. As visibility shifts and unit effectiveness changes from dawn to dusk, new challenges and opportunities emerge.

Get creative with the extensive level and character creators. Design custom maps with unique terrain and play styles. Craft your own commander—whether it's a fun, unique character or the most powerful leader possible.

Lead your forces through four different campaigns in a war for global supremacy. Capture cities, unlock new characters, and battle for a world under your faction’s banner.

Everyone Fights gives a new city-building spin to the familiar turn-based war gaming genre. Try it out!
